description: Bind an Aeroz chip to a graded collectible slab (PSA, CGC, SGC, BGS, TAG). The chip UID, grader, cert number, grade and card identity are signed together, so the chip vouches for exactly this label: a label moved to another holder, or a cert reprinted on a copy, shows as "binding broken" on a buyer's tap. For PSA, the cert is cross-checked against PSA's own record when PSA_API_TOKEN is configured; a disagreement flags the item. `grader_check` is match, mismatch, not_found, unavailable (nobody looked), or unverified_identity (the grade agrees but the grader's record does not confirm the card). A chip that has ever been bound to a graded item is refused (use a new chip), and so is a grader cert already bound to another chip — for a re-holdered slab, retire the old binding with record_provenance first. Returns the public verify URL to encode in the slab's QR. This does NOT grade the card and does not claim the card was unaltered before sealing — never present it as either.

public.description: Resolvable by a public tap (default true).

uid.description: Chip UID bonded to the slab (at most 64 characters, as verify_chip accepts).
